Hidden Gem
Jul 2019 • Friends
If I didn’t know Manuel, one of the owners of Pho Ong Tay, I would never have found the restaurant, tucked away down a side street in Thao Dien. The name means “Western Man’s Pho” and yes, Manuel and his partner, Trang, make great Pho - trad or non- trad, such as with salmon, but what not so many people perhaps realise is that Manuel is an excellent Italian chef. From his daily fresh pasta to the wide range of excellent sauces to baked dishes, as well as tasty burgers, risotto and home made breads and piadina, the food is well made, tasty and the prices are very reasonable. He does a pretty mean lemon meringue tart as well!

Best Italian Restaurant Ever
May 2019 • Friends
Have eaten in Pho Ong Tay endlessly and always found their Italian food to be consistently excellent and the most delicious of any Italian restaurant. Their burgers are pleasant and salads and salad dressings are wonderful but it is the Italian food which keeps me coming time and time again. I have tried all of the Italian dishes now but whilst all of them are superb, it is the Penne Carbonara which is my firm favourite and is the best not only in Vietnam but the best anywhere. A mention must also be made of the french fries which are definitely the best in town - not too overcooked, not too crisp, not saturated in oil - but the ultimate in french fries. The restaurant is also very flexible and as the portions of french fries are so generous the restaurant is happy to serve half portions if asked for. I haven't yet tried the Vietnamese food but friends tell me their pho is delicious. Finally, there is a very good range of wines which completely complement the meal. I also have many take always when I work late, as well as sitting in the restaurant and it is very noteworthy that the deliveries come just as piping hot as when I visit the restaurant. This is a definite plus to my mind as I really do dislike luke warm or cold food. Pho Ong Tay does not disappoint.

The best food in Thao dien !!
Jun 2019 • Family
It’s been already few month since Me and my Familly have been a loyal customer of this incredible restaurant . This place is run by an amazing power couple,where they take absolute pride in their cooking . You can see the freshness of all ingredients being handpicked by them and love and dedication put into their creations . The hardest thing in food industry is to keep consistency ,they manage to keep every meal tasting the same as your last visit and even better , never a disappointment . The menu can fulfill any customers ,since its varies from salmon ,steaks ,deep focus on REAL Italian pasta and not forgetting about cultural dishes of the incredible place where we live ,even PHO has a special touch of combining western /and Vietnamese culture in it ,and don’t forget about their desserts all home made as well crepes filled to the Max with Nutella and yummy tiramisu and many more. I surely can claim that any customer by trying their food at least once will be returning . Even my picky toddlers obsessed with their food,so mommy can have a day off from cooking and let Pho ong tay feed them . Their restaurant is super Cozy ,with great environment and friendless of the owners and staff . I absolutely love the little balcony upstairs . It’s suitable for anyone ,couples ,lunch stop ,Familly with kids and even events . Also I would like to mention how amazing their delivery is ,super fast ,they really doing their best not to turn hungry customers into hangry 😂
As my headline says best food in thao dien for sure !

Great local for Quoc Huong area!
Dec 2018 • Friends
A colleague who lives nearby introduced me to this Italian-Vietnamese combo. It's always so good to find a quiet spot in walking distance. I didn't try any of the Vietnamese dishes but the homemade pasta was truly fresh and light as air! You can choose your pasta and then choose the fresh sauce you prefer. There is a selection of different fresh sauces daily. Staff was very accommodating to add a few more of our favorite ingredients to make a custom sauce. The Greek salad was a very generous portion we could split between 2-3 people. I wouldn't mind seeing a few more wines in low price range. Will definitely be back.
